tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bstan srung chen mo dpal ldan rdo rje rab brtan ma'i rjes gnang bzhugs so// dpal brtsegs kyi par ma las yang zhus can 'di dag pa yin/ bla ma mchog dang rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir bstan srung chen mo dpal ldan rdo rje rab brtan ma'i rjes gnang byed pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bla ma yi dam khyad par lha mo 'di nyid kyi sku rab gnas dang ldan pa'i mdun ngos su stegs bu'am/ cog tse la sogs pa'i steng du dar ram ras la chu tshon gyis bris pa'am/ yang na rdul tshon gyis maṇḍal gru gsum mthing nag re khā rim pa gnyis kyis bcad pa/ phyi rol du zlum po rim pa gnyis bskor ba la thod rwa dkar po/ de'i phyir me ri rlung nag g.yas bskor du 'bar ba/ zla gam gsum dang chos 'byung gi nang dmar por byas pa'i dbus su/ ral gri rtse gyen du bstan pa'am/ kaṃ yig gam/ tshom bu dmar nag rnams gang rung bkod/ de'i khar mañdzi'i steng du lcags snod la sogs pa'i nang du gtor ma lcags mkhar gyi rnam pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa steng dang sgo rnams kyi thad du thod skam gyi rtsig pa steng gi dbus dang phyogs mtshams rnams su mi ro rengs pa'i rnam pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs pa/ logs rnams su rgyu ma dang don snying gi drwa ba dang drwa phyed/ de rnams kyi lcags mkhar gzhi ma nag po thod skam rnams dkar po/ mi ro dang rgyu rlon rnams khrag gis dmar por byugs/ steng nas dar nag gi gur phub/ mdun du 'bul gtor lag len ltar bshams pa dang / khrag gi argha sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i drag po'i nyer spyod rnam lnga/ bandha lcang lo can gnyis su sman phud dang rakta bsham/ gzhan yang phyag mtshan gyi ral gri/ ne'u le'i rkyal pa/ mda' dar la sogs pa spyan gzigs rol mo'i bye brag sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad ma tshang bar med par bshams/ de nas rnal 'byor pas gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa yi dam khro bo gang yang rung ba'i bdag mdun mchod bstod bzlas pa/

gtor ma 'bul ba la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun gyi lha mo'i rten dang gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i lha mo 'khor bcas bskyed pa nas/ bskang bshags kyi bar gtor chog ltar tshang bar bya/ khyad par bzlas pa'i skabs su lha mo'i thugs rgyud bskul bar bsams nas/ lha mo'i sngags kyi bzlas pa stong phrag gam/ brgya rtsa las mi nyung ba bzlas/ rjes gnang dngos la slob ma rnams khrus byas/ snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas gral la 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i ngang nas 'di skad brjod par bya'o/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bstan srung chen mo dpal ldan rdo rje rab brtan ma'i rjes su gnang ba zhus la nyams su len snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa legs par gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de yang dam pa'i chos zab mo nyams su len pa la bar chad sel zhing mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i srung ma khyad par can re bsten dgos par gsungs pa las/ 'dir mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud dang / lha mo shan pa nag mo'i rgyud la sogs pa ma mo spyi'i skye rgyud rnams nas/ lha ma hā de bar grags pa dbang phyug chen po dang / lha mo u ma de ba zhes bya ba e ka dza ṭi dang / bka' bzlog ma sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs mang po dang ldan pa 'di gnyis lhan cig tu 'dus pa las sras ming po ma hā kā la dang / sring mo lha mo nag mo tsa munt+ri te/ ming sring gnyis byung ba las/ 'dir sring mo lha mo tsā munt+ri/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs dpal ldan lha mo nag mo dang lha mo dkar mo dung skyong ma dang / parṇa sha ba ri sogs mtshan yongs su grags pa brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa dang ldan pa 'di ni rje mo re ma ti zhes bya ba gur gyi mgon po'i lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma dang /

da lan 'dir 'byung ba'i dpal ldan lha mo 'di nyid la sogs pa rnams yin te/ yang lha ma hā de ba dang srin po dha sha gre ba'i sring mo na la rtse gnyis 'dus pa las bu mo gcig byung ba ni srin mo dmar ldan phur pa lha zhes bya/ sbas pa'i bu mo thal mdog ma dang / bdud mo re ma ti dang / nag mo re ma ti la sogs pa mtshan gyi rnam grangs du ma dang ldan pa 'di ni khol mo re ma ti zhes bya ba da ltar lha mo dmag zor rgyal mor grags pa la sogs pa rnams yin/ rje mo re ma ti 'di nyid la'ang rgyud rgya gzhung so so'i dgongs pa/ bla ma brgyud pa so so las 'ongs pa'i sku mdog phyag mtshan bsgrub tshul sogs mi 'dra ba mang du ma 'byung ba las/ da lan 'dir skabs su babs pa gsang sngags rnying ma la bsten pa'i ma mo nag mo spu gri'i rgyud la sogs pa nas bshad cing / slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs lha mo rang nyid kyis/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug la dngos su gnang ba rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang gi lha mo'i sku 'dra'i phyag mtshan ne'u le'i nang du sbas pa dus phyis ne'u le'i rkyal pa chag pa'i nang nas yon btsun seng ges bton nas zhal bshus byas phyi mo slar yang de nyid du bzhugs pa'i sgrub thabs ne'u le'i rkyal par grags pa nas bstan pa'i dpal ldan lha mo 'di ni sngon byang chub kyi shing drung du bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po nyid kyi spyan sngar srog gi snying po mdong gsol du phul nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing bstan pa srung bar khas blangs dam bcas/ de bzhin du dpal he ru ka dang phyag na rdo rje dang rta mgrin la sogs pa'i spyan sngar yang bstan pa srung bar khas blangs dam bcas/ 'phags yul rdo rje gdan gyi byang shar mthing smug 'bar ba'i brag phug na ma mo 'bum sde'i gtso mo mdzad pa'i tshe/ ma mo he la 'bar mar mtshan gsol/

nub phyogs u rgyan gyi gnas su mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi gtso mo mdzad nas mi sha mi khrag gsol ba'i tshe/ rdo rje sna yon mar grags/ rgya gar shar phyogs za hor rgyal po'i yul khams skyong ba'i tshe/ rdo rje mdzo zhon mar btags/ bod yul du bstan pa snga dar gyi dus slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis chos 'khor grom pa rgyang kyi gter gyi srung mar bskos nas lha mo dre'u zhon ma'am rdo rje rgyang grags mar grags/ bsam yas dpal gyi gtsug lag khang gi srung mar byon pas rdo rje gshog rgod mar mtshan gsol/ dkar chung rgya sde'i srung ma mdzad pa'i tshe/ rdo rje g.yu sgron ma zhes bya/ mnga' ris stod kyi spu rangs gtsug lag khang dang / gu ge tho ling gi skor srung mdzad pa'i tshe/ rdo rje dbang grub mar mtshan gsol/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi smad nas dar ba'i thog mar/ dbus gtsang gi mi bcus mdo khams su bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi drung du byon nas/ bslab pa blangs te dbus gtsang du byon pa'i gtso bo'am/ bgres pa lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis rgyan gong byang chub dge gnas kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ de'i mkhan bu lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas kyi zhwa lu gser khang gis gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ de'i dus thar pa'am dpyal ston nag po thog 'bebs dang zhwa lu ba mthu 'gras che bar byung / lo drug bdun gyi bar du thog ser phab nas/ zhwa lu ba'i skya chag thams cad nyams thag par gyur pa'i tshe lo ston gyi dgongs pa la 'di lta bu'i mthu bzlog pa'i bstan srung khyad par can zhig spyan 'dren dgos 'dug snyam nas rgya bal gyi phyogs su chas te byon pa thang dpal mo dpal thang du phebs pa dang / de na rlung nag 'tshub ma chen po gcig gi gseb na bud med smug nag chen mo dre'u la zhon pa ya mgal gnam dang / ma mgal sa'i bar du gdengs pa/ nu ma phrag pa la bkal ba/ shin tu 'jigs pa'i cha byad can zhig dang mjal bas bred cing sngangs par gyur pa'i tshe/

bud med de na re/ khyod gang nas 'ong / gang du 'gro/ don du gang gnyer ba yin zer ba la/ bdag gtsang zhwa lu zer ba nas 'ongs/ dpyal nag po thog 'bebs kyi rbod gtong zug nas de bzlog pa'i srung ma drag shul can zhig spyan 'dren du rgya bal gyi phyogs su 'gro ba lags gsungs pas bud med de na re/ de ltar na khyed kyi srung ma ngas byed kyi gsungs pa dang / bud med kyi chos skyong gis thar pa ba'i mthu mi bzlog gam byas pas/ khyod la gang dgos kyi 'phrin las thams cad ngas bsgrub par nus gsungs nas shog dril gcig gnang nas/ 'di slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i nga'i sgrub thabs yin/ khyod la nga nam dgos pa byung tsa na 'di sgrogs shig gsung / 'o na yid ches pa'i rdzu 'phrul zhig ston dgos byas pas/ bud med des lag pa g.yas pa sdigs mdzub byas nas chu bo chen po gcig 'dug pa la bstan pas chu bo gyen la bzlog nas gram pa sngo cher byung bas nus mthu la yid ches/ khyed kyi mtshan la gang zer/ gnas gang na bzhugs dris pas/ nga rgya gar rdo rje gdan na gnas pa'i tshe/ he la 'bar ba zer/ u rgyan gyi yul na rdo rje sna yon ma zer bya ba la sogs pa'i mtshan dang gnas kyi rnam grangs mang po bshad byung bas/ khyed ma phyin dgu phyin ma byas dgu byas kyi rigs su 'dug pas nga la phan thogs pa zhig mi yong ba 'dra gsungs pas/ de ltar mi dgos khyed rang gi gtsug lag khang du nga yi gzugs brnyan zhon pa med pa zhabs sa la brtan par btsugs pa/ de'i mdun du dre'u nyal ba gcig dus tshes 'di lta bu la grub par gyis/ de'i tshe nga rang dngos su 'ongs nas rten de nyid la brtan par gnas te khyod kyis gang bsgo ba'i las thams cad thogs med bsgrub pa yin gsung / nga'i ming rdo rje rab brtan mar thogs shig zer nas 'ja' yal ba ltar song / der lo ston gyis rgyan gong du log nas gtsug lag khang de'i sgo khang du lha mo 'di'i sku dre'u dang bcas pa bzhengs pas/

sngar gyi khas blangs pa'i dus tshes la lha mo 'di rkang thang du byon/ dre'u la khal bkal 'khor tshogs mang po dang bcas pa phyogs thams cad du 'ur sgra dang thug sgra chom sgras gang bar byon nas/ sngar bzhengs pa'i rten rnams la mngon sum du thims nas dus deng sang gi bar du gtsug lag khang 'di na lha mo 'di mngon sum du bzhugs shing 'phrin las sgrub par the tshom med cing yid ches pa 'di yin/ de nas lan gcig lo ston gyi gzim mal du sngar gyi shog dril de lus pa kho rang gi lug rdzi gcig gis rnyed nas lug 'tsho bar khyer te/ lo ston gyis mdzad pa'i gdangs la dpe byas/ bhyo sgra dang spel nas bsgrags pas/ bud med nag mo 'khor gsum btags pa gcig byung nas khyod nga bos nas ci byed/ ngas khyod la lug dar ba'i dngos grub byin gyis/ shog dril 'di lo ston la sprod cig gsungs pa dang / lug rdzis shog dril lo ston la phul lo/ /de ltar na sgrub thabs ne'u le'i rkyal mar grags pa 'di/ lha mo 'di'i sgrub thabs kyi rtsa ba bsgrags pa tsam gyis kyang lha mo mngon sum du 'byon nges pa yin pas/ yid ches shing gces par zungs shig de'i dus na thar pa rnams bsgros pa la/ lo ston gyis rgya gar nas srung ma gcig gdan drangs yod 'dug pas/ rang re'i bla ma sku mtshams dam po mdzad pa drag zer nas zhus pas/ dpyal nag po thog 'bebs sku mtshams dam po la bzhugs/ nye gnas la mtshams kyi bar la su yang ma gtong gsungs/ de'i gnang bzhes kyi dus su srung mas rgyud bskul nas/ yon bdag drag par rang gcig po mjal ba la byung ba de nye gnas kyis mtshams 'og tu btang bas/ de dang mnyam du srung ma 'di g.yu'i sbrang bu gcig tu sprul nas byon pa bla mas ngo mkhyen nas bzung ste/ lcags kyi par bu gcig gi nang du bcug nas bzhugs gdan gyi 'og tu mnan/ nga'i gdan la sus kyang ma reg cig gsungs pas/

bla ma mi bzhugs sa zhig la nye gnas kyis bzhugs gdan gyi 'og nyul nas lcags par gyi kha phye bas de'i nang na g.yu sbrang nyams pa gcig nam mkha' la 'phur song / de'i nub mo bud med nag mo lcags kyi sder mo can gcig gis mar me bsad nas lag pa gcig bla ma'i gzim khang gi sgo gong la rgyab/ lag pa gcig gis bla ma'i snying bton nas khyer te tshar bcad/ lo ston la dngos grub kyi thog ma dgra 'dul bar mdzad/ de'i tshe lha mo 'di nyid gnyan zhing rtsub la drag shul che ba'i snyan grags kyis phyogs thams cad du khyab par gyur/ de phyin zhwa lu pa rnams kyis kyang srung ma 'di chos skyong gi gtso bor bzung bas ci 'dod kyi phrin las bsgrubs pas dar zhing rgyas par gyur/ dus deng sang gi bar du mkhan brgyud dang / chos brgyud 'dzin pa rnams kyi lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs nas bar chad sel zhing phrin las thams cad thogs med du sgrub/ de lta bu'i gtam rgyud lo rgyus kyang shin tu mang bar yod/ mdor na zhwa lu ba'i grwa pa nges ma tsam gyis kyang phyi bzhin 'brangs nas bar chad sel zhing mthun rkyen bsgrubs par yongs su grags pa yin/ de ltar snying nye zhing drag shul dang mthu stobs shin tu che ba'i dpal ldan lha mo 'di nyid la mchod gtor dbul zhing / bsnyen sgrub la sogs pa byed par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas brgyud pa rnam par dag pa las 'ongs pa'i rjes su gnang ba'am/ bka' gtad legs par thob pa zhig dgos pas/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba'i rim pa rnams legs par grub zin/ slob ma dang thun mong du bya ba'i rim pa la/ dang por yon dbul zhing gsol ba btab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ da ltar gyi rdo rje'i slob dpon 'di nyid gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa yi dam gyi lha dngos yin snyam pa dang / de'i drung du dpal ldan lha mo nag mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu ba'i ched du 'bul snyam pas maṇḍal tshom bu bdun pa zhig 'bul bar zhu zhes brjod nas/

las kyi rdo rjes maṇḍal tshom bu bdun pa zhig bshams nas slob ma rnams dang lhan cig tu 'bul/ de ltar yon dbul ba sngon du song nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes bzlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni 'gro la phan don du/ /gtso chen khyod la gsol 'debs kyis/ /lha mo'i rjes gnang bka' drin stsol/ /ces lan gsum brjod/ 'di lta bu'i srung ma khyad par can gyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i sngon du/ theg pa chen po'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa zhig nges par dgos pas/ slob dpon yi dam lhar gsal ba las sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang / mdun 'di nyid du dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i steng ngos su brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa sprin phung gtibs pa ltar mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rang nyid kyi yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sgo nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/ de nas ye shes dbab pa'am/ rjes su gnang ba'i gzhi bca' ba'i slad du/ sems gzhan du ma yengs pas 'di bzhin du bsgom par mdzod/ mdun gyi rten dang gtor ma rnams 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim pa las byung ba'i dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa mngon sum du bzhugs pa khyed rang rnam pa'i blo ngor gsal 'debs pa ni/ zhes lha mo 'khor bcas kyi mngon rtogs rgyas par brjod/ de'i tshe rdo rje slob dpon yi dam lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas steng phyogs lha'i yul yongs 'du ljon pa'i nags tshal chen po dang / rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang shar mthing smug 'bar ba'i brag phug nub phyogs u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang /

dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang / dkar chung rgyas sde'i gnas mchog grom pa rgyang gi lha khang / rgyan gong byang chub dge gnas kyi gtsug lag khang / dpal zhwa lu gser khang gi chos grwa chen po/ gzhan yang yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa nas dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa sngon gyi thugs dam rjes su dran pas nam mkha' la sprin gtibs pa'am/ bar snang la char babs pa'am/ sa gzhi la rlung nag po 'tshub pa bzhin du 'ur sgra dang bcas pa thogs med du byon nas mdun gyi lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa la rgya mtsho chen po la char babs pa'am bye ma la chu sim pa bzhin du thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ zhes brjod la/ thod rnga rkang gling la sogs pas sna drangs/ gu gul/ tshil chen/ sha chen gyi dud pa sbyar/ rnga brdung zhing dbyangs dang bcas pas spyan 'dren gyi tshig brjod pa'i rjes su/ snying po'i mthar rakmo du ra la sogs brjod cing / rol sgra drag po byas/ de nas gdan dbul phyag 'tshal gtor ma 'bul la/ bstod pa dang bcas pa bya/ de nas sman raka 'bul ba'i tshe/ slob ma gcig gam mang po yod na gtso bo zhig gi lag tu sman raka gi bandha sprad la/ lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis nam mkhar 'thor du gzhug sman raka 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad rnams rnga brdung zhing dbyangs dang bcas pas brjod/ de bzhin du/ bskang bshags kyi tshe slob dpon rnams langs te phyag 'tshal ba'am/ rten la me tog 'thor du 'jug pa la sogs pa'i phyag len yang mdzad do/ /dngos gzhi'i byin rlabs la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang yi dam gyi lha dbyer med pas bdag la dpal ldan lha mo nag mo chen mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i byin gyis brlab pa dang rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa bstsal du gsol zhes lan gsum brjod/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi lha mo la phog pas/ lha mo'i dpral ba nas lha mo sku mdog dkar po 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa ltar byung nas slob ma'i dpral bar thim pas lus la sku'i byin rlabs zhugs shing bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/

slob ma'i lus dang lha mo'i sku dbyer med du gyur par bsams la/ yi dam gyi sngags kyis 'go drangs pa'i lha mo'i snying po'i mthar a be sha ya āḥ.aḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod cing spos rol bya/ de bzhin du/ lha mo'i mgrin pa nas lha mo dmar mo 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba dang / thugs ka nas lha mo mthing kha 'od zer mthing kha 'phro ba dang / gnas gsum nas dus gcig car du lha mo dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ slob ma'i mgrin pa snying ga sgo gsum du gcig car thim/ ngag yid sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ ngag yid sgo gsum dang / gsung thugs sku gsum dbyer med du ro gcig tu gyur/ gsang dbang she rab ye shes/ dbang bzhi pa rnams rim bzhin thob par bsam la/ re re la'ang sngar bzhin sngags brjod cing spos rol drag po bya'o/ /lha dngos kyi rjes su gnang ba'am/ gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba ni/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun gyi dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas rang dbang med par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i thad kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ur ding byon byung ba'i steng dngos su brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyang gsal btab/ de'i tshe rtsa ba'i bla mas ji ltar bka' bsgo ba bzhin brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis kyang mgrin gcig tu bka' bsgo ba'i mos pa mdzod zhes brjod cing / gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la rol mo dang bcas pas lha mo'i snying po'i mthar/ slob dpon chen po padma thod 'phreng bstsal/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas/ lce btsun ye shes dbang phyug lce 'bum me/ lce 'bum dar/ lce 'bum ldan/ g.yu thog sgra gser bzang / lce ye shes 'bar/ mkhan po mngon pa ba/ bu ston seng ge 'od/ 'di la bu ston rin po ches gsan/ mkhan po grags pa gzhon nu/ bla ma 'di la thugs sras pas gsan ces mkhyen rab rje'i gsung spod kyi thob yig las byung bkris seng ge

bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/ sku zhang chos rje nam mkha'i mtshan can/ de la rdo rje 'dzin pa rin chen dpal grub dang / ka bzhi pa rin chen rgyal mkhyen rab rje'i gsan yig tu ka bzhi pa la gtor gtad gsan zhes 'byung mtshan/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang chen po mkhyen rab mchog grub dpal bzang po/ ka bzhi pa rin chen mchog grub dpal 'bar/ rje btsun sprul pa'i ḍā ki la rje btsun ḍā ki mas chos rje bzhi pa las gsan par snang / des 'khrul zhig pa la gsan nam snyam/ thob yi ga la nges pa cher mi snang bas thams cad bsdus nas bris pa yin/ 'khrul zhig rig 'dzin tshul khrims rgyal mo/ chos kyi rje bstan pa brag dkar ba rab gsal/ chos kyi sgog lung pa rje bkra shis dpal 'byor ba rnams 'di gnyis la bka' gtad thob/ kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dpal ldan lha mo nag mo re ma ti/ 'dod khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ bdud kyi yum mchog gshin rje'i sring mo/ dgra dang bgegs kyi gshan pa/ nad dang rims kyi bdag mo/ zas su mi sha dmar po za ba/ skom du snying khrag dron mo 'thung ba/ dmar gyi ro myong zhing khrag gi dri tshor na rdzu 'phrul gyis dpag tshad brgyad khrir rgyug pa'i nam gru khram thogs chen mo dpal ldan rdo rje rab brtan ma/ ming po klu chen thod dkar/ las mkhan klu bdud nag po/ khol mo chu srin gdong can/ dkar mo zhal gyi pho nya mo 'bum/ sngon mo ral pa 'dzings pa mo 'bum/ dmar mo chen mo gtum pa mo 'bum/ ser mo rdo rje mkha' la bzhad pa mo 'bum/ bka' yi pho nya ba lang dre'u sna ma/ las kyi pho nya khri sman sa le ma/ sprul pa'i pho nya ma yams nag mo/ seng ge dang stag dang dur bya la sogs pa sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams sngon byang chub shing drung du bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dang gzhan yang gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/

rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po/ dpal he ru ka yum chen e ka dza ṭi rnams kyis zhal dngos su mthong zhing rang rtags srog gi snying po mdong gsol du phul nas khas blangs shing dam bcas pa ni/ phyi rabs kyi rnal 'byor pa gang zhig gis lha mo bdag nyid sgrub cing bsten pa dang / yi dam du bgyid pa de dag gi phyi bzhin du 'brang bar bgyi'o/ /ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub sbyin no/ /de'i ging ka ra ba bgyi'o/ /de la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag la zas skal dang / 'thung skal bgyi'o/ /zhes zhal gyis bzhes shing bro bor ba ltar rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams dus da lta nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs la byin pa'i zas zo/ bcol ba'i las gyis/ 'gal rkyen sol/ mthun rkyen sgrubs/ 'di dag la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad ma thogs myur ba nyid du bsad cing bsgral ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod pas/ lha mo 'khor dang bcas kyis de ltar bgyi'o zhes zhal gyis bzhes/ 'khor rnams mtha' nas rim bzhin me long la has btab pa bzhin 'od du zhu nas/ gtso bo la thim/ de nyid kyang dges shing chags la 'dzum zhing bzhad pa'i nyams dang ldan pas 'od zer bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du zhu nas slob ma'i spyi bo nas thim pas/ lha mo'i sku gsung thugs dang / slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum chu la chu 'dres pa ltar dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres par bsams la lus sems khong glod nas brjod bral bde ba chen po'i ngang du ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par bzhag de'i rjes su 'od gsal gyi ngang las slob ma dpal ldan lha mo nag mo 'khor dang bcas pa nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba ltar skad cig gis khra lam nge shar bar bsams la/ dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal drag po bya'o/ /'phrin las sgrub pa phyag mtshan gyi rjes gnang ni/ slob ma lha mor gsal ba'i lag pa g.yas su ral gri rno ngar dang ldan pa gtad la/

srin po nag po'i g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /dam nyams mgo bo gcod pa'i ral gri 'di/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu la sbyin par bya/ /gdug can tshar chod mthu rtsal dbang thob shog /ces dang / lha mo'i snying po brjod/ lag pa g.yon du ne'u le'i rkyal pa dang dngos sam gzugs brnyan gang rung gtad la/ dngos grub nor bu'i gter mdzod ne'u le/ /'dod dgu'i char 'bebs nor gyi rkyal bu 'di/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu la sbyin par bya/ /dpal 'byor nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang thob shog /ces dang snying po brjod/ sngags kyi bzlas pa'i lung sbyin pa ni/ slob dpon yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun gyi lha mo'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul lha mo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bhyo yig smug nag la sngags kyi yig 'bru chu bur rdol ba ltar tho lo lo byung zhal nas thon/ slob ma lha mor gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bhyo yig smug nag la sib sib thim pas/ lha mo'i srog rgyud dbang du 'dus shing sngags kyi bzlas pa'i lung thob par bsam la/ bla ma'i 'phreng ba la 'jus te/ tadya thā/ oṃ ro ru bi tiṣṭha ba tot+si ma ma rakmo tsitta kha rakmo bhyo bhyo swā hā/ zhes bdun nam nyer gcig gi rjes bzlos bya/ slob mas bka' drin rjes su dran pas me tog 'thor zhing / lha mo bdag la bstsal lags kyis/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ slob dpon gyis slob mas phul ba'i me tog gi phreng ba sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas/ slob ma'i spyi gtsug tu bstims pas sngags kyi nus pa brtan zhing byin gyis brlab par bsams la/ lha mo 'di la bstsal lags kyis/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /dpal ldan lha mo nag mo chen po rdo rje rab brtan ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs rje nus pa mthu stobs rig sngags kyi nus mthu thams cad rdo rje slob ma 'di'i rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod/

des rjes su gnang ba'i dngos gzhi legs par thob nas/ dus de nyid du khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs la srung sdom bgyid snyam pa'i 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ rjes gnang zab mo thob pa'i bka' drin gyi yon du maṇḍal tshom bu bdun pa dbul/ lus longs spyod thams cad 'bul gyis drug cha la sogs pa cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ de dag gis dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya che ba dang / khyad par 'di nyid kyi bsnyen sgrub mchod gtor la brtson par bgyis pas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don thams cad bde blag tu 'grub par 'gyur ba lags/ de ltar rjes su gnang ba'i tshul 'di ni rje btsun bla ma ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma'i zhal las ji ltar thob pa yid la gsal bar bcangs pa dang / phyis su zhwa lu ri phug gi bu ston rin po che'i gzim chung mun khang gi gdung srubs nas 'di'i rjes gnang gi thob yig mdzad byang med pa'i shog 'phyar rnyed pa 'di gnyis tshig ris mi 'dra ba cung zad tsam ma gtogs khyad par cher mi snang bas dpang po'i tshul du byas nas don la rang bzo'i dri mas ma gos pa zhwa lu pa'i mkhan brgyud dang / chos brgyud 'dzin pa rnams la bsam nas bklag chog gi tshul du bkod pa yin zhing / mkhyen rab rin po che'i zhal slob phal cher bka' gtad kho na mdzad pas de ltar na yon dbul zhing thun mong ma yin pa gsol gdab byas nas gtor ma lha mor gsal ba slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag nas/ sngags brjod cing bka' bsgos pas slob ma'i phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i yid ches khyad par can byed do/

/de ltar dpal ldan lha mo'i rjes gnang / bka' gtad kyi yi ge 'di ni dpal zhwa lu gser khang gi gdan sa bcu gsum pa shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos 'dar stod mang mkhar gyi sa'i cha/ rang gi bsti gnas kyi yang rtse bde chen yangs pa can gyi pho brang du legs par sbyar ba 'dis kyang dpal ldan lha mo rab tu mnyes shing bstan pa rin po che phyogs thams cad du rgyas par gyur cig 'di ni zhwa lu slob brgyud yin nges lha mo 'di chos skyong gi gtso bor 'dzin pa re re tsam la sbyin zhing gzhan dag la mkhas 'dod dang ngo bsrungs kyis 'chol bar mi ster zhing / yi ge 'di'ang su byung la mi ston pa'i bka' rgyas btab ste/ de'i gtad gnyer las mkhan klu bdud nag po dang / ma mo ba lang nag mo la gtad pa yin par thub par gyis shig sa ma ya/ /dge zhing bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ bstan srung chen mo dpal ldan rdo rje rab brtan ma'i rjes gnang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
